ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3,
Residential Single Unit (Detached House) and B3-1, Community Shopping District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-H in the area bound by:

South Damen Avenue; a line 80 feet south of and parallel to West 69" Street; the alley
next east of and parallel to South Damen Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to
West 69" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Wolcott Avenue; a line 75
feet south of and parallel to West 69'" Street; South Wolcott Avenue; the alley next south
of and parallel to West 69'" Street; South Marshfield Avenue; West 71° Street; the alley
next west of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to
West 71° Street; South Wood Street; West 71° Street; a line 124.68 feet east of and
parallel to South Damen Avenue; a line 123.3 feet north of and parallel to West 71°
Street; South Damen Avenue; a line 400 feet south of and parallel to West 69"" Street;
the alley next east of and parallel to South Damen Avenue; and a line 300 feet south of
and parallel to West 69" Street,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
